purpose: Test whether a focused frontend profile change improves independently evaluated artifacts through the existing Hermes delivery loop.
baseline_behavior_commit: Established by the setup commit: prior SOUL/comic skill plus the captured runtime-generated offline-learning-card Skill.

cases.topic: 两个孩子都想用同一支公用画笔，商量轮流使用；同时让孩子理解自己带来的个人物品可以自主决定是否借出。
孩子不小心弄坏同学做的纸作品，诚实说明发生的事，听取对方感受，并商量力所能及的补救。
孩子拼一幅有点难的拼图，先做力所能及的尝试，卡住时说清困难并寻求合适帮助；理解求助不等于把整件事交给别人。

common_input: 请为中文6-8岁儿童制作一个离线学习小页面。围绕给定主题写一个有开头、困难、选择与结果的短故事，以及两道三选一选择题。每个选项都要有友善具体的反馈；答错可以重试，有重置按钮。故事与题目内容由你创作。制作单文件 index.html，内嵌 CSS/JS，手机和桌面均可用，不依赖网络、图片生成或第三方包；可用简单 CSS 装饰。另写 lesson.json：{title,age_range,learning_goal,story:[字符串],questions:[{id,prompt,options:[{id,text,feedback}],answer}]}。两题 id 为 q1/q2，各题选项 id 为 A/B/C，answer 为选项 id；页面内容须与 JSON 一致。为自动验收，题目容器用 data-question='q1'/'q2'，选项 button 用 data-option='A'/'B'/'C'，反馈元素用 data-feedback，重置按钮 id='reset'。本次制作学习页面，不制作漫画。主题：
delivery_instructions: 执行并交付实际文件。使用已登记的 demo-team 工作区，读取项目 AGENTS.md 与当前 frontend SOUL.md，确认实际 git HEAD。只在 .harness/results/{delivery_id}/ 写输出，不修改任何 profile、Skill、记忆或源码，不提交 Git，不读取其他试验的产物/评估。目录包含 index.html、lesson.json、result.json、manifest.json。result.json 必须是对象，记录 profile='frontend'、delivery_id='{delivery_id}'、source_revision 为实际 git HEAD、summary 和真实自检及局限。manifest.json 为 {"artifacts":[{"path":"index.html","name":"index.html","kind":"document","content_type":"text/html"},{"path":"lesson.json","name":"lesson.json","kind":"data","content_type":"application/json"}]}。实际检查文件及 JSON，不声称做了未做的浏览器检查。不要自行 finalize，由调用方收集。不要安装依赖或生成图片；尽量在一次实现加自检内完成。
iteration: Baseline and round1 development feedback can inform the next focused change. Keep transfer-case scoring sealed until round2 is frozen. Repeats are scheduled in their respective version blocks to avoid needless redeployments; version order is not randomized.
change_scope: Only profiles/frontend/skills/offline-learning-card/SKILL.md is the experimental behavior variable. The observed generated Skill is versioned unchanged in the setup baseline. No control-plane feature development or new runtime.

scale.4: clear, precise, and effective in this artifact

grading.pass: Each dimension >=3 and no hard fail; deterministic browser and artifact checks also pass.
grading.method: Two independent model judges, same available model family, opaque artifact labels, different presentation orders, visible page text and all feedback plus browser evidence; no version, hypothesis, revision, or runtime-cost metadata.
grading.retain_rule: Retain round2 only if all its samples pass deterministic and semantic gates for both judges, each judge sees development mean at least 1/16 above baseline, and transfer mean (two samples per version) and minimum per-dimension score do not regress. Otherwise restore baseline. Report judge disagreement and all failures; no selecting the best sample.
grading.inference_limit: Practical pilot decision threshold, not statistical significance, real child learning efficacy, or proof of general reliability.

budget.infrastructure_retries: Reuse idempotency keys; never replace a failed sample with a better one. One corrected protocol rerun is allowed only when the trial is technically invalid, with both preserved.

evidence: effective SOUL/Skills/config/memory fingerprints before and after each run
result and artifact downloads with SHA256
opaque judge inputs and raw scores
state_control: For this controlled pilot, disable auxiliary.background_review.enabled only for frontend via native Hermes config CLI using session-authorized development SSH, and restore its original behavior after the experiment. Record the fixed effective config and all SOUL/Skill/memory fingerprints before/after each run; verify Skill loading in trace. No global setting or source-code hotpatch. Deployment and task/result loop remain through existing HTTP APIs.
